_comment: Environment adapter: Frostwalker (Nexus 184628). Besides reading explosion and projectile names,
Frostwalker asks whether an actor has an active magic effect with Frostwalker_FrostCloak_Keyword
(freeze water where it walks) or Frostwalker_FireCloak_Keyword (melt ice): include/Manager.h,
ShouldFreezeWater / ShouldMeltIce, actor->HasMagicEffectWithKeyword. A cloak's own effect (archetype
Cloak) is what stays active on the caster, so these lines put the keyword there: an ordinary keyword
line, the cloak spell's catalog frost or fire resting on the record (tierMin manual - a cloak's
element comes from the damage it applies), not both. Frostwalker's own KID ini gives them to a few
vanilla cloaks only. Frostwalker_WaterCloak_Keyword (hardens lava) is left out: it was not asked for,
and water rests on framework keywords alone on every TAKEALOOK spell but one (2026-10-20).
